about: Human-authored §18 acceptance expectations. Test assertions only; never Laya or Claude input, never bundled into the web app or a client-visible table.

interpretations.R01: School incident with limited source claim; does not prove every school building is clear.
interpretations.R03: Separate possible life-safety concern at the residence.
interpretations.R04: New evidence of unresolved need, not another incident or extra heatmap weight.
interpretations.R05: School update/paraphrase about the gym subarea; preserve source scope.
interpretations.R07: School correction/uncertainty; highlight possible unresolved harm without claiming a confirmed person.
interpretations.R08: Possible repeat with unresolved concern; do not delete it or add headcounts.
interpretations.R09: School location/subarea clarification, not a new place inferred from sender GPS.
interpretations.R10: Question, not confirmation of a person or a completed rescue.
interpretations.R11: Delayed older gym report; does not override R07.
interpretations.R12: Unresolved school update; do not mark resolved.

invariants.mustNot: create an incident or add heatmap weight
confirm a person or a completed rescue
